description: This source file defines a utility function `ensureZippedPlaywrightReport` that checks for the existence of a Playwright report directory or zip file, and creates a zip archive of the report if necessary. It also includes logic to run this function when the script is executed directly.

methods.name: ensureZippedPlaywrightReport
methods.description: Checks for existing zip report files or directory; if not present, creates a zip archive of the Playwright report directory.
